source: splunk_exam_questions.json, single-answer only (221 of 241; 20 multi-select held out, no recorded answer)

cards.question: When linking key/value pairs in search strings, what syntax is used?
Out of the following queries, which search string returns a field where the number of matching events is stored, and then stored as Purchases?
cards.answer: index=access_combined_wcookie status=200 file="success.do" | stats count as "Purchases"

cards.question: Which of the following search strings only returns events from the source access_30day.log?
What is the default retention period of a search job in Splunk?
In a typical Splunk deployment, which of the following components is found on the machine that originates the data?
When a scheduled report is run, what is the scope of the data that will be included in the report?
cards.answer: Reports display all information accessible to the owner.

cards.question: The Boolean operator is just one of many search term components in Splunk. Which of the following is true about the boolean operator?
cards.answer: A boolean must be written in uppercase.

cards.question: What search would return error events in index db_audit or failed or failing events in index linux_secure
Based on the following search string, choose the answer that displays the correct pipe placement: index=main sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie status=403 stats count as Transactions
cards.answer: index=main sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie status=403 | stats count as Transactions

cards.question: When using the top command within your query, which of the following constraints can be applied?
Based on Splunk's recommendations, which of the following is the best practice for naming conventions?
How can search results be preserved if they need to persist for more than 7 days after they are searched?
Splunk search best practices include which of the following?
cards.answer: Filter by adding search terms as early as possible.

cards.question: If you look at the dashboard panel that is based on a report, which of the following statements is true?
cards.answer: The search string in the panel cannot be modified, but the visualization can be altered.

cards.question: What are some of the common constraints associated with the top command?
Which of the following is true about line charts when displaying search results based on splunk best practices?
cards.answer: Single and multiple series are best represented by line charts.

cards.question: Following a search, how are events displayed?
When attempting to modify user account settings and preferences, which of the following is true?
cards.answer: Clicking the login name in the Splunk bar will allow you to define the full name, time zone, and default app.

cards.question: A scheduled report serves what primary purpose?
cards.answer: Automatically generating and sending reports at regular intervals.

cards.question: What happens when you click and drag across the timeline after running a search?
cards.answer: Filters the results of the current search.

cards.question: How can a static lookup file's contents be reviewed?
What must be done in order to use a lookup in Splunk?
cards.answer: The lookup file must be uploaded to Splunk and a lookup definition must be created.

cards.question: When sorting on multiple fields with the sort command, what delimiter can be used between the field names in the search?
Which time range picker configuration would return real-time events for the past 30 seconds?
What is the correct syntax to count the number of events containing a vendor_action field?
What is one benefit of creating dashboard panels from reports?
cards.answer: Any change to the underlying report will affect every dashboard that utilizes that report.

cards.question: By default, which of the following fields would be listed in the fields sidebar under interesting Fields?
Which of the following statements about case sensitivity is true?
cards.answer: Field names ARE case sensitive; field values are NOT.

cards.question: What does the rare command do?
cards.answer: Returns the least common field values of a given field in the results.

cards.question: When an alert action is configured to run a script, Splunk must be able to locate the script. Which is on of the directories Splunk will look in to find the script?
Which Boolean operator is always implied between two search terms, unless otherwise specified?
What does the values function of the stats command do?
cards.answer: Lists unique values of a given field.

cards.question: Which stats command function provides a count of how many unique values exist for a given field in the result set?
A collection of items containing things such as data inputs, UI elements, and knowledge objects is known as what?
Which statement is true about Splunk alerts?
cards.answer: Alerts are based on searches that are either run on a scheduled interval or in real-time.

cards.question: What is the purpose of using a by clause with the stats command?
cards.answer: To group the results by one or more fields.

cards.question: How do you add or remove fields from search results?
cards.answer: Use fields + to add and fields - to remove.

cards.question: A field exists in search results, but isn't being displayed in the fields sidebar. How can it be added to the fields sidebar?
cards.answer: Click All Fields and select the field to add it to Selected Fields.

cards.question: In the fields sidebar, which character denotes alphanumeric field values?
What is the main requirement for creating visualizations using the Splunk UI?
cards.answer: Your search must transform event data into statistical data tables first.

cards.question: What user interface component allows for time selection?
Which of the following searches will return results where fail, 400, and error exist in every event?
When placed early in a search, which command is most effective at reducing search execution time?
Which of the following is the most efficient filter for running searches in Splunk?
How does Splunk determine which fields to extract from data?
cards.answer: Splunk automatically discovers many fields based on sourcetype and key/value pairs found in the data.

cards.question: Which of the following file types is an option for exporting Splunk search results?
What syntax is used to link key/value pairs in search strings?
Which search string returns a field containing the number of matching events and names that field Amount of Events?
cards.answer: index=security failure | stats count as "Amount of Events"

cards.question: Which search would return events from the access_combined sourcetype?
Which of the following index searches would provide the most efficient search performance?
What is a suggested Splunk best practice for naming reports?
cards.answer: Use a consistent naming convention so they are easily separated by characteristics such as group and object.

cards.question: In a deployment with multiple indexes, what will happen when a search is run and an index is not specified in the search string?
cards.answer: Events from every index searched by default to which the user has access will be returned.

cards.question: When viewing the results of a search, what is an Interesting Field?
cards.answer: A field that appears in at least 20% of the events.

cards.question: When a Splunk search generates calculated data that appears in the Statistics tab, in what formats can the results be exported?
Which search matches the events containing the terms "error" and "fail"?
Which of the following is an option after clicking an item in search results?
cards.answer: Adding the item to the search.

cards.question: Which of the following fields is stored with the events in the index?
Which of the following is the recommended way to create multiple dashboards displaying data from th same search?
cards.answer: Save the search as a report and use it in multiple dashboards as needed.

cards.question: What does the following time range do? earliest=-72h@h latest=@d
cards.answer: Look back from 3 days ago, up to the beginning of today.

cards.question: Which events will be returned by the following search string? host=www3 status=503
cards.answer: All events with a host of www3 that also have a status of 503.

cards.question: What does the stats command do?
cards.answer: Calculates statistics on data that matches the search criteria.

cards.question: Which is a primary function of the timeline located under the search bar?
cards.answer: To show peaks and/or valleys in the timeline, which can indicate spikes in activity or downtime.

cards.question: What can be configured using the Edit Job Settings menu?
cards.answer: Change Job Lifetime from 10 minutes to 7 days.

cards.question: Which command is used to validate a lookup file?
Which statement is true about the top command?
How can another user gain access to a saved report?
cards.answer: The owner of the report can edit permissions from the Edit dropdown.

cards.question: What is the primary use for the rare command?
cards.answer: To find the least common values of a field in a dataset.

cards.question: What happens when a field is added to the Selected Fields list in the fields sidebar?
cards.answer: The selected field and its corresponding values will appear underneath the events in the search results.

cards.question: By default, which of the following is a Selected Field?
According to Splunk best practices, which placement of the wildcard results in the most efficient search?
Which command automatically returns percent and count columns when executing searches?
Which of the following describes lookup files?
cards.answer: Lookups add more fields to results returned by a search.

cards.question: Which search string is the most efficient?
Which search string matches only events with the status_code of 404?
In the Fields sidebar, what does the number directly to the right of the field name indicate?
cards.answer: The number of unique values for the field.

cards.question: Which of the following is the best way to create a report that shows the last 24 hours of the events?
cards.answer: Use the time range picker to select "Last 24 hours".

cards.question: When is an alert triggered?
cards.answer: When results of a search meet a specifically defined condition.

cards.question: Which search will return the 15 least common field values for the dest_ip field?
Which Field/Value pair will return only events found in the index named security?
When is the pipe character, |, used in search strings?
cards.answer: Before commands. For example: |stats sum(bytes) by host

cards.question: What are the three main Splunk components?
How can results from a specified static lookup file be displayed?
Which statement describes field discovery at search time?
cards.answer: Splunk automatically discovers only fields directly related to the search results.

cards.question: Which of the following is a metadata field assigned to every event in Splunk?
What are the two most efficient search filters?
Assuming a user has the capability to edit reports, which of the following are editable?
Which of the following reports is available in the fields window?
What is a quick, comprehensive way to learn what data is present in a Splunk deployment?
cards.answer: Click Data Summary in Splunk Web

cards.question: When refining search results, what is the difference in the time picker between real-time and relative time ranges?
cards.answer: Real time searches display results from a rolling time window, while relative searches display results from a set length of time.

cards.question: Which of the following is an accurate definition of a field within Splunk?
cards.answer: A searchable key/value pair in event data.

cards.question: Which of the following need to be specified when utilizing the lookup command in search?
Which of the following is a false statement about Splunk dashboards?
cards.answer: Splunk dashboards may not be directly created from search results without first creating a report.

cards.question: When viewing results of a search job from the Activity menu, which of the following is displayed?
cards.answer: The same events from when the original search was executed.

cards.question: Which steps do you need to take in order to be able to create a report with line chart content?
cards.answer: 1. Create a search 2. Select the Visualization tab 3. Click Save As > Report 4. Select a Line Chart as the content

cards.question: Given the following SPL search, how many rows of results would you expect to be returned by default index=security sourcetype=linux_secure (fail* OR invalid) | top src_ip
What are Splunk alerts based on?
Which of the following is the appropriately formatted SPL search?
cards.answer: index=security sourcetype=linux_secure (invalid OR failed) | stats count as "Potential Issues"

cards.question: By default, which role contains the minimum permissions required to have write access to Splunk alerts?
Which of the following is the best description of a Splunk App?

A SOC manager is complaining that a scheduled alert for failed login attempts triggered 150 emails. They still want to be alerted of failed logins via email, but they want less volume of alerts. Which of the following would resolve this for the SOC manager?
cards.answer: Change the trigger from “For each result” to “Once”

cards.question: In the search and Reporting app, which is a default selected field?
Which one of the following statements about the search command is true?
cards.answer: It behaves exactly like search strings before the first pipe.

cards.question: Which of the following actions can the eval command perform?
cards.answer: Create or replace an existing field.

cards.question: When can a pipe follow a macro?
cards.answer: A pipe may always follow a macro.

cards.question: A data model consists of which three types of datasets?
Where are the results of eval commands stored?
When should transaction be used?
cards.answer: When event grouping is based on start/end values.

cards.question: When performing a regular expression (regex) field extraction using the Field Extractor (FX), what happens when the require option is used?
cards.answer: Only events with the required string will be included in the extraction.

cards.question: Which of the following is the correct way to use the datamodel command to search fields in the Web data model within the Web dataset?
cards.answer: | datamodel Web Web search | fields Web*

cards.question: Which of the following searches will return events containing a tag named Privileged?

Given the macro definition below, what should be entered into the Name and Arguments fields to correctly configure the macro? Definition: sourcetype=access_combined action=$action$ JSESSIONID=$JSESSIONID$ | stats values(action) as action by JSESSIONID
cards.answer: The macro name is sessiontracker(2) and the arguments are action, JSESSIONID.

cards.question: What is required for a macro to accept three arguments?
A user wants to convert numeric field values to strings and also to sort on those values. Which command should be used first, eval or sort?
cards.answer: Use sort first, then convert the numeric to a string with eval.

cards.question: How does a user display a chart in stack mode?
cards.answer: By changing Stack Mode in the Format menu.

cards.question: What other syntax will produce exactly the same results as | chart count over vendor_action by user?
What are the two parts of a root event dataset?
When using timechart, how many fields can be listed after a by clause?
cards.answer: 1, because _time is already implied as the x-axis.

cards.question: A field alias has been created based on an original field. A search without any transforming commands is then run in Smart Mode. Which field name appears in the results?
cards.answer: Both will appear in the Interesting Fields list, but only if they appear in at least 20 percent of events.

cards.question: Which of the following statements describes macros?
cards.answer: A macro is a reusable search string that may have a flexible time range.

cards.question: In what order are the following knowledge objects/configurations applied?
In which of the following scenarios is an event type more effective than a saved search?
cards.answer: When the search string needs to be used in future searches.

cards.question: When using the transaction command, what does the argument maxspan do?
cards.answer: Sets the maximum total time between the earliest and latest events in a transaction.

cards.question: When creating a Search workflow action, which field is required?
To identify all of the contributing events within a transaction that contain at least one REJECT event, which syntax is correct?
After manually editing a regular expression (regex), which of the following statements is true?
cards.answer: It is no longer possible to edit the field extraction in the Field Extractor (FX) UI.

cards.question: Which of the following statements describes POST workflow actions?
cards.answer: POST workflow actions can be configured to send POST arguments to the URI location.

cards.question: Which of the following statements is true, especially in large environments?
cards.answer: The stats command is faster and more efficient than the transaction command.

cards.question: What does the following search do? index=corndog type=mysterymeat action=eaten | stats count as corndog_count by user
cards.answer: Creates a table of the total count of mysterymeat corndogs eaten, split by user.

cards.question: Which of the following statements describes the search string below? | datamodel Application_State All_Application_State search
cards.answer: Events will be returned from the data model named Application_State.

Which workflow uses field values to perform a secondary search?
Which of the following statements describes field aliases?
cards.answer: Field aliases can be used in lookup file definitions.

cards.question: Which statement is true?
cards.answer: Pivot is used for creating reports and dashboards.

cards.question: Which of the following statements describes the use of the Field Extractor (FX)?
cards.answer: Fields extracted using the Field Extractor persist as knowledge objects.

cards.question: Which of the following searches would return a report of sales by product_name?
cards.answer: chart sum(price) as sales by product_name

cards.question: What is a limitation of searches generated by workflow actions?
cards.answer: Searches generated by workflow actions run with the same permissions as the user running them.

cards.question: Which of the following is a function of the Splunk Common Information Model (CIM)?
cards.answer: Normalizing data across a Splunk deployment.

cards.answer: GET workflow actions can be configured to open the URI link in the current window or in a new window.

cards.answer: When you need to group based on start and end constraints.

cards.question: Which of the following statements about tags is true?
cards.answer: Tags can make your data more understandable.

cards.question: Which of the following file formats can be extracted using a delimiter field extraction?
A user wants to create a new field alias for a field that appears in two sourcetypes. How many field aliases need to be created?

In the following eval statement, what is the value of description if the status is 503? index=main | eval description=case(status==200, "OK", status==404, "Not found", status==500, "Internal Server Error")
cards.answer: The description field would contain no value.

cards.question: In which Settings section are macros defined?

cards.answer: Calculated fields are a shortcut for repetitive and complex eval commands.

cards.question: Which of the following are required to create a POST workflow action?
Which of the following is one of the pre-configured data models included in the Splunk Common Information Model (CIM) add-on?

cards.answer: The user is unable to return to the automatic field extraction workflow.

cards.answer: The CIM provides a methodology to normalize data from different sources and source types.

cards.answer: Reusable pieces of search processing language.

cards.question: How is a macro referenced in a search?

cards.question: Which of the following statements describes POST workflow actions?
cards.answer: POST workflow actions can open a web page in either the same window or a new window.

cards.question: What is the purpose of a calculated field?
cards.answer: To automatically add fields at search time using an eval expression rather than manually including an eval command.
